qa_pairs.question: What should I do first when troubleshooting the control unit operating motor?
qa_pairs.answer: Disconnect the 'control unit - operating motor' 7 pin plug.

qa_pairs.question: Where do I connect connection (1) during testing?
What voltage should I apply to connection (6)?
What should happen when I test the clutch switching?
qa_pairs.answer: Clutch must be heard to switch on.

qa_pairs.question: What should I do if the clutch doesn't switch on during the initial test?
What connections should I test on the 7-pin plug of the operating motor?
qa_pairs.answer: Connect ground on connection (2) and B + on connection (5) of 7-pin plug of operating motor.

qa_pairs.question: What should I listen for when testing the operating motor?
qa_pairs.answer: Operating motor must be heard to run.
